headline: Peruvian sol strengthens as dollar falls amid global weakness
summary: The US dollar closed at S/3.44 in the Peruvian interbank market, a 0.46% decline, following a drop in oil prices and global dollar weakness.
why: The exchange rate in Peru is influenced by global commodity prices, particularly oil, and the strength of the US dollar in international markets.

impacts.name: USD/PEN
impacts.why: Global dollar weakness directly impacts the local exchange rate.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The local currency strengthened due to the broader weakening of the US dollar in global markets and the impact of commodity price fluctuations.
